title: Your First Weekend at Stevenson University, Shared as Cards
description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence using Stevenson’s recurring campus spaces, welcome activities, and student programming.

cards.title: Start with Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: New-student connection activities
cards.notes: Check the current Welcome Week schedule, meet your Orientation Leader, and use the sessions to learn campus routines before choosing your next stop.
cards.short_summary: A structured way to meet people and get oriented during the opening weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says Welcome Week and Student Life Orientation connect new students through small-group discussions, social events, and educational sessions.
cards.source_title: The New Mustang Experience | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: For new students; consult the current University schedule for event details.

cards.title: Browse the Involvement Fair
cards.subtitle: Semester-start student organization event
cards.notes: Walk the fair, ask one practical question at each table, and save the meeting details for organizations you may want to try next week.
cards.short_summary: A recurring semester-start introduction to Stevenson’s official clubs and organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson documents an involvement fair at the start of each semester where students can ask club representatives questions and sign up for meetings.
cards.access_notes: Occurs at the start of each semester; check current Student Life announcements.

cards.entity_name: Center for Student Life and Leadership
cards.title: Settle into the CSLL
cards.subtitle: Garrison Hall South, Owings Mills
cards.notes: Use the collaborative setting to compare weekend plans, find a quiet seat for a reset, or ask student leaders about club and event opportunities.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated student-life space for collaboration, individual work, and social downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson describes the CSLL as an 8,000-square-foot space with collaborative tools, multifunctional rooms, club offices, and individual study space.
cards.access_notes: Located in Garrison Hall South; access and programming may vary.

cards.title: Meet over a Rockland meal
cards.subtitle: Owings Mills Campus dining hall
cards.notes: Coordinate a meal with new hallmates, then use the time to swap schedules and choose one campus event or space to explore together.
cards.short_summary: Stevenson’s all-you-care-to-eat dining location on the Owings Mills Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s resident handbook identifies Rockland Marketplace as an all-you-care-to-eat dining option on the Owings Mills Campus.
cards.access_notes: Dining requires an applicable meal plan, Flex dollars, or other payment method.

cards.title: Find your library rhythm
cards.subtitle: Owings Mills North Campus
cards.notes: Take a short walk through the study areas, identify a quiet pod or group table, and save the library desk location for future research help.
cards.short_summary: A 42,000-square-foot academic hub with individual and collaborative study options.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says the Philip A. Zaffere Library provides group study areas, reservable rooms, quiet individual pods, and traditional tables.
cards.source_title: Philip A. Zaffere Library | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Located on Owings Mills North and connected to the Manning Academic Center and School of Design.

cards.title: Move at Caves
cards.subtitle: Caves Sports & Wellness Center
cards.notes: Bring your SUOne card, confirm the day’s hours, and try a brief workout or walk-through so the fitness center feels familiar before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: An Owings Mills fitness center with official evening and weekend student hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson lists Caves Fitness Center hours, including student access until 10:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Regular-semester hours list Monday–Thursday until 10:30 p.m.; hours can change during breaks or special events.

cards.title: See Mustang Stadium
cards.subtitle: Owings Mills Campus athletics venue
cards.notes: Check the current athletics or campus schedule, then visit during permitted access to get familiar with the stadium and its surrounding campus paths.
cards.short_summary: A named Owings Mills athletics landmark with student card-access periods.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson’s hours page lists Mustang Stadium and states weekend student SUOne-card access from 10 a.m. to midnight, subject to game-day changes.
cards.access_notes: Weekend student card access is listed 10 a.m.–midnight; game days can change access.

cards.title: Look for a MAP program
cards.subtitle: Student-programmed campus entertainment
cards.notes: Check current MAP listings, invite a new acquaintance, and choose a low-key program such as the documented monthly movie series to attend together.
cards.short_summary: A student programming board that brings entertainment and a monthly movie series to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says the Mustang Activities and Programming Board brings free entertainment to campus, including a monthly movie series.
cards.access_notes: Programs vary by date; consult current Student Life communications for location and attendance details.

cards.title: Try an Arts Alive! workshop
cards.subtitle: Participatory arts and design activity
cards.notes: Watch for a current workshop listing and choose a hands-on session that interests you; arrive ready to participate and introduce yourself to another attendee.
cards.short_summary: Participatory arts programming ranging from craft workshops to guest-artist presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson documents Arts Alive! activities and participatory workshops including tin-type photography, bread making, felting, jewelry making, and weaving.
cards.access_notes: Offerings are event-based; verify the current program, location, and any materials requirements.

cards.title: Use Garrison as a meet-up point
cards.subtitle: Owings Mills Campus
cards.notes: Pick the North Lobby as a simple rendezvous point, review the day’s plans, and leave enough time to reach your next campus activity without rushing.
cards.short_summary: A named Garrison Student Union lobby with published regular-semester building hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson publishes regular-semester hours for the Garrison Student Union North Lobby, including weekend opening times.
cards.access_notes: Listed regular-semester hours: Saturday 7:30 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sunday 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; hours may change.
